product_metadata.title: Rustic 3 Tier Wooden Spice Rack - Farmhouse Kitchen Countertop Cabinet Organizer - Vintage Distressed White Wood Seasoning Jar & Condiment Storage Holder - Dessert Stand Cupcake Riser Display Shelf
features: ENDLESS HOME DECOR POSSIBILITIES: This three tier spice rack is a perfect pantry organizer, looks great on coffee bars, and beautiful on kitchen countertops.
RUSTIC FINISH: A distressed wood finish gives this 3 tiered white seasoning organizer for cabinets a rustic look that adds warmth and style; it’s the perfect farmhouse decor for your home.

PERFECT SIZE - PERFECT FIT: Measuring 12" long x 7" deep x 3" high, your spice holder fits perfectly in most cabinets and displays on the counter for easy organization and storage without taking too much space.

NOT JUST A SPICE ORGANIZER FOR CABINETS: Organize your desk at the office; use them on the bathroom counter as helpful nail polish and skincare organizers, toiletry displays, or essential oil storage. This decorative rack can also be used as a dessert stand and cupcake riser for weddings, bakeries & restaurants.
BEAUTIFUL WOOD RUSTIC DECOR: Durable but lightweight design offers three 2.25" shelves to display and store your spices and organize your smaller items with ease.
description: Finally, an Organizer that’s both functional and beautiful

You deserve a better spice rack for your cabinet and kitchen counter. Our new Paper + Pallet Three Tiered Spice Rack is beautifully designed with a rustic, distressed white finish and made from lightweight, yet durable wood. It fits perfectly in your cabinet and makes finding your seasonings easy, but with so much care to its design and finish, you'll love displaying it right out on the counter or use it in your pantry for added organization.

As part of our Farmhouse Collection, your brand new Spice Rack Organizer fits beautifully with the rest of your rustic and farmhouse kitchen decor and specially designed to add an extra touch of warmth and style to your home.
-12" wide (with 11" of usable shelf space) x 7" deep x 3" high,
You will receive one beautifully made Three Tiered Spice Rack Display Organizer, fully assembled and ready for your space.
(Bottles of Spices & Seasonings are used in the pictures to show suggested uses. Sold Separately)
Paper + Pallet is a family-owned and operated home decor company out of northern Iowa.
